documents.title: Critical edition introduction
documents.text:
Critical edition introduction — Book of Hessin (fictional).
In this document "BOH-MS" means Book of Hessin. Book of Hessin reports quire count of 15 for FY2024 under the original agreement. Book Logistics subsidiary reports lacunae share of 30.1% for FY2025. BOH-MS reports recorded variant readings of 793 for FY2024. Book of Hessin reports number of scribal hands of 6 for FY2025. The fiscal year of Book of Hessin ends on 30 June.

documents.title: Catalogue entry
documents.text:
Catalogue entry — Book of Hessin (fictional).
Book of Hessin reports quire count of 11 for FY2024 under the amendment no. 1 (supersedes). Book of Hessin reports lacunae share of 25.4% for FY2025. Book of Hessin reports line count of 34 for FY2024. Book of Hessin reports radiocarbon median date (CE) of 1175 year for LTM to 30 Jun 2025.

documents.title: Review article
documents.text:
Review article — Book of Hessin (fictional).
Book of Hessin reports recorded variant readings of 1068 for FY2024. Book of Hessin reports copyists of 5 for FY2025. Book of Hessin reports line count of 30 for FY2024. Book of Hessin reports radiocarbon median date (CE) of 993 year for FY2025 (fiscal year ending 30 June 2025). "copyists" has the same meaning as "scribal hands".
